newsitem.title: USA: World Air enters wet lease with Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: World Air enters wet lease with Indonesia.

text.p: World Airways Inc said on Monday that it entered a minimum $30 million wet lease agreement with Garuda Indonesia, the national air carrier of Indonesia.
Garuda will outsource flying to World Airways during Indonesia's 1997 peak passenger season, which runs from March through May, World Airways said.

The agreement calls for World to supply four MD-11 and two DC-10-30 aircraft, along with cockpit crews, maintenance and insurance, to transport pilgrims between Indonesia and Saudi Arabia, World Airways said.
